name: pinguin-game
//engines: A FLOOR AND A CEILING, both inherited from the sibling repos rather than re-derived. Floor: Vite 8 / Vitest 4 need Node 20.19+ or 22.12+. Ceiling: from Node 25 onward Node defines its own `localStorage` global, Vitest therefore never installs happy-dom's, and any test touching it dies pointing at the setup file instead of at Node. This repo's unit tests are pure and run in the `node` environment, so the ceiling does not bite here YET — it is declared anyway, because the first test that needs a DOM would otherwise discover it the hard way. `.nvmrc` pins 24, which is what CI and any deploy build on.
//overrides: Transitive, BUILD-TIME-ONLY advisory, and VERIFIED still necessary here rather than copied across: with the override removed, npm resolves cookie@0.6.0 under @sveltejs/kit 2.70.2 and npm audit reports 3 low advisories. None of it reaches this app — SvelteKit pulls cookie for server-side helpers that adapter-static plus ssr=false never run. npm audit fix cannot resolve it without downgrading SvelteKit, so the version is pinned by hand and checked the way that matters: lint, typecheck, the unit suite and a production build all green afterwards. Revisit when SvelteKit bumps its own dependency.
